newsitem.title: USA: Polo Ralph, others sue for infringement.
newsitem.headline: Polo Ralph, others sue for infringement.

text.p: Polo Ralph Lauren Corp. and other major clothing and apparel manufacturers Tuesday sued several small retail stores and their landlords for trademark infringement Tuesday.

The lawsuit filed in U.S. District Court in New York alleges the retail stores sell counterfeit goods. It also charges that the landlords of the retail stores knew of the infringement and thus contributed to the illegal conduct.

The plaintiffs include Rolex Watch USA Inc., Louis Vuitton Malletier, Oakley Inc., Sara Lee Corp., Donna Karan Studio, Donna Karan International Inc., Gabrielle Studio Inc., Nautica Apparel Inc., Tommy Hilfiger Corp., Guess? Inc., Chanel Inc. and Calvin Klein Inc.

The retail stores and landlords being sued are Tien Le Jewelry, TN Discount Store, Thien Kim Jewelry, Amigo, ABC Inc., Tina Enterprises, Kathy, L&T Gift Co., Broadway & Canal Realty Corp., Uncle Tom Inc., Sports Plaza Inc., Canal Gift Shop, A&G Gift Shop, China Buddhist Association, 3M Trading Co. Inc., ML Boutique and John Davino.

Polo Ralph Lauren and the other plaintiffs requested an injunction enjoining the stores from using the clothing and apparel manufacturers' trademarks, an injunction enjoining the landlords from renting to stores for the sale of counterfeit goods and $1 million in damages from each defendant.
